channels.name: TXp
channels.purpose: Positive line of the differential transmit pair.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, NRZ at 32 GT/s Gen5; four-phase enhanced TX equalization; optional precoding
channels.idle_level: Electrical Idle when LTSSM not in L0/L0s

channels.name: TXn
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential transmit pair.

channels.name: RXp
channels.purpose: Positive line of the differential receive pair.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, NRZ at 32 GT/s; CTLE+DFE; mandatory Lane Margining at the Receiver

channels.name: RXn
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential receive pair.

channels.name: REFCLK+
channels.purpose: Positive line of 100 MHz reference clock; SSC-tolerant; Common Clock or SRIS.

channels.name: REFCLK-
channels.purpose: Negative line of 100 MHz reference clock.

channels.name: WAKE#
channels.purpose: Pulled LOW to resume from L2/L3.

global_signals.name: REFCLK
global_signals.purpose: 100 MHz reference clock for all components in a Common Clock domain.

global_signals.name: PERST#
global_signals.purpose: Fundamental reset distributed to every component.

global_signals.name: WAKE#
global_signals.purpose: Open-drain wakeup signal; any device can assert to wake the system from L2/L3.

handshake_pairs.name: TLP-ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Ack DLLP for the highest good Sequence Number.

handshake_pairs.name: TLP-NAK
handshake_pairs.rule: Nak DLLP with last good Sequence Number; replay from Retry Buffer.

handshake_pairs.name: TS1-TS2-DataRate
handshake_pairs.rule: Training-set exchange carrying the Data Rate Identifier (incl. 32.0 GT/s bit) + Alternate Protocol Negotiation.

handshake_pairs.name: EQ-Phase-0-3
handshake_pairs.rule: Four-phase enhanced equalization exchanging transmitter coefficient/preset requests, incl. retimers.

handshake_pairs.name: Lane-Margining
handshake_pairs.rule: Margining commands/status via the Lane Margining at the Receiver registers / margining SKP ordered sets; runs in L0 without interrupting traffic.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Each Lane is autonomous at the bit level (CDR + 128b/130b block lock + scrambler + elastic buffer) at 32 GT/s. Lanes cooperate at de-skew + striping. TX and RX directions are independent (dual-simplex). The LTSSM coordinates both directions; Recovery.Equalization runs the four-phase enhanced EQ (incl. retimers) before sustaining 32 GT/s.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: TLP transmission requires: (1) sufficient Flow Control credits, (2) DL_Active, (3) LTSSM L0 at the trained rate (32 GT/s after successful equalization). Sustaining 32 GT/s requires a converged Phase 0-3 equalization. Lane Margining requires L0 and does not interrupt traffic.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active TX symbol stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Continuously driven differential signaling carrying 8b/10b-encoded TLP / DLLP / Idle / Ordered-Set data.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical Idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Transmitter outputs no symbol stream; differential output is undriven (or held at common mode).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Beacon
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: 30 kHz to 500 MHz modulated pulses on the differential pair used to wake the Link from L2 when REFCLK is off.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: Byte is 8b/10b-encoded then transmitted LSB of the 10-bit symbol first on the wire (per Figure 4-3, Bit Transmission Order on Physical Lanes).
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Little-endian for multi-byte fields within TLP headers (matches PCI convention).
ordering_rules.lane_striping: Multi-Lane Links stripe successive bytes round-robin starting at Lane 0; STP/SDP MUST land on Lane 0.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Dual-simplex: TX and RX transmit independently and simultaneously.
ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Serial NRZ; 128b/130b block boundaries delimited by the 2-bit sync header.
